agent.name: Silver-Milk Team Promethean Classification Agent
agent.specialty: Promethean significance classification (incremental, breakthrough, potential Promethean) under Fortino Ch. 11 barrier tests, with two-direction confidence and the weight broad significance should carry in a present decision

analytical_question: What significance classification does the supplied evidence support for text-to-image diffusion, how confident should management be, and how much should that classification influence the proposed application decision?
general_et_finding:
EVIDENCE BASE: Supplied cards
UNIT CLASSIFIED: Text-to-image diffusion systems, with latent diffusion as the reference architecture.
PARENT SYSTEM: Generative AI.
LAYER 1: System — trained weights, compute, conditioning and an interface form a usable image-generation system; latent diffusion architecture alone is a component.
BARRIER STATEMENT: Before this technology, producing a new image from a verbal specification required human visual construction or adaptation using drawing, photography, rendering or existing assets; this was not experienced as a limitation but as the definition of image production. Qualified: earlier generative systems and automation already relaxed this constraint; diffusion is not established as the first alternative.
SUPPRESSION TEST: Observed — S8 (2022) establishes an accessible system; S5 (2023) and S12 (2025) establish continuing alignment errors. S11 (2024) reports labor-market change but cannot isolate diffusion. Whether removing this unit restores the constraint is unresolved because substitutes and dependent systems are insufficiently documented. Prospective — dependent image-production workflows are plausible, not demonstrated by these cards.
DISSOLUTION: Reduced — S5 and S12 document errors that retain human interpretation and correction as conditions of reliably realizing specifications.
IF DISSOLVED, TIERS: Economic activity; cognitive and social life — inferred potential reach, not demonstrated dissolution.
LAYER 3 CRITERIA: not scored (Layer 2 gate).
EARLIEST UNRESOLVED GATE: Suppression.
SIGNIFICANCE CLASS: Indeterminate (Incremental | Breakthrough).
WHY NOT LOWER: Incremental alone would assert a barely reduced barrier without measuring its reduction against human-led image production. Automated synthesis is demonstrated; substantial workflow-level reduction remains unmeasured. Deciding evidence: a dated measurement against that pre-technology workflow. Reassessment date: 2027-04-20.
HIGHER-SIGNIFICANCE HYPOTHESIS: Breakthrough — generating images from text substantially reduces human visual construction; the missing causal link is measured reduction in total human work, including correction, against the pre-technology workflow.
MODE: Prospective.
CEILING: Potential Promethean.
application_finding:
WHAT THIS USE DRAWS ON: Text-conditioned image synthesis can supply visual material for internal concepts and mood boards, reducing some manual image construction or selection. The present workflow already produces these outputs using catalogue references, manual boards and a freelance designer; final photography and copy remain separately authored and checked.
APPLICATION SIGNIFICANCE: Incremental — the proposed use assists an existing ideation activity without removing its approval constraint or changing its output. This is an application-level interpretation of the case, not a measured claim about savings.
organization_specific_finding:
UNIT OF ANALYSIS: The retailer's owner and marketing staff assessing how much broad technological significance should count in their internal concept-image decision over six weeks.
CORE ACTIVITY ON BARRIER: No — revenue comes from selling homeware, not producing images.
CONSEQUENCE FOR THE ORGANIZATION: Low — the proposal concerns supporting ideation; assortment, sales channel and fulfilment remain unchanged, and ideation's share of costs is unknown. This is an inference from the case.
REVERSIBILITY OF THE DECISION: Reversible — internal concepts can be discarded and the established workflow restored within one budget cycle at low cost, assuming no substantial contractual commitments.
WINDOW EVIDENCE: None found — no supplied dated external item shows an opportunity closing for comparable retailers; investor urgency is not window evidence.
WEIGHT OF BROAD SIGNIFICANCE ON THIS DECISION: Low — core activity is not on the barrier and no dated window is established. The indeterminate class is weighted as Incremental.
POSTURE EFFECT: The aggressive posture permits greater tolerance of uncertainty about broad significance in this reversible internal setting, with proportionate review rather than high-confidence reliance. Its six-week decision horizon provides an earlier occasion to revisit material evidence than the general classification's 2027-04-20 reassessment; posture changes neither class nor weight.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: EVIDENCE FOR HIGHER CLASS: S8 (2022) establishes accessible text-to-image generation, and S11 (2024) reports a 17% decline in image-creation postings. Together they support the Breakthrough hypothesis, but neither measures the unit's reduction of human work against the pre-technology workflow.

EVIDENCE AGAINST HIGHER CLASS: S5 (2023) and S12 (2025) document persistent alignment errors, preserving human correction. They challenge barrier dissolution, although they do not rule out a substantial reduction sufficient for Breakthrough.

STRONGEST CASE FOR LOWER CLASS: Earlier visual tools already supported image production, S3 (2022) measures an intra-family improvement, and correction may consume much of the apparent gain. Incremental remains plausible, but no supplied comparison demonstrates that the pre-technology barrier is only barely reduced.

DISTINGUISHING EVIDENCE: Dated evidence by 2027-04-20 measuring total human work for comparable image-production outputs against the pre-technology workflow would distinguish substantial from slight reduction. Sustained removal of the constraint, named dependent systems and evidence across tiers would be necessary for a higher dissolution judgment.
The source cards provide abstract-level or announcement-level summaries, not an exhaustive account of 2026 capabilities. Their preparer's source checks are not independent retrieval in this run.
No supplied dated item establishes use or value in comparable small homeware retailers. Local value, organizational consequence and reversibility are therefore case-based inferences.
Fortino's framework is the stipulated working instrument, not an established academic consensus. Funding, popularity and investor urgency supply no missing causal evidence.
confidence_and_uncertainty:
CONFIDENCE AT LEAST Indeterminate (Incremental | Breakthrough): Moderate — the cards support a usable system and a qualified, reduced barrier, but do not resolve the magnitude of reduction; evidence that equivalent outputs receive negligible workflow benefit would lower the assessment toward Incremental.
CONFIDENCE NOT HIGHER: Moderate — no supplied dated measurement establishes substantial reduction against the pre-technology workflow; such a measurement would raise the supported class to Breakthrough and weaken confidence in the current ceiling of inference.
Both directions are capped at Moderate by the indeterminate judgment and abstract-level evidence. Assumptions: the classified unit is a usable text-to-image diffusion system, and reliable realization of specifications includes correction. Confidence in local value is Low because no system, price, license or measured saving is specified.
value_opportunity_implication: The plausible value is broader or less labor-intensive internal visual exploration. Neither the magnitude of that benefit nor its contribution to the retailer's costs is established. Broad technological significance supplies no substitute for local value evidence.
risk_governance_implication: Low significance weight does not imply low failure consequences. Misleading product appearance, unsupported brand references and accidental publication remain case-specific concerns. The retained human correction requirement makes review relevant, while present licensing and governance sufficiency remain outside this classification judgment.
recommendation_management_implication: WEIGHT: Low — broad significance should count as background in this decision. The retailer's own application value, risks and readiness should carry the substantive judgment. The supported general class is Indeterminate (Incremental | Breakthrough), weighted as Incremental; neither investor enthusiasm nor a civilization-scale analogy changes that result. This classification supplies no basis for increasing the decision's scale or urgency.
change_monitoring_triggers: Upward class: dated measurement showing substantial reduction of human work against the pre-technology image-production workflow would resolve the class toward Breakthrough.
Downward class: affirmative measurement showing only slight reduction against that workflow would resolve the class toward Incremental.

Dissolution upward: sustained evidence of reliable image production without the named human construction or correction constraint, together with dependent systems, would support changing Reduced to Dissolved.

Dissolution uncertainty: credible conflicting evidence about removal of the constraint, with no decisive item, would support Not yet determinable; a corresponding class change would still require the specified tier conditions.
Suppression gate: dated evidence identifying dependent systems and what happens without diffusion, while accounting for substitutes, would resolve the current suppression uncertainty.
Weight upward to Moderate: a dated external item demonstrating an opportunity closing for comparable organizations would change the window entry; excitement or an internal deadline would not.
Weight reassessment: a material change making image production the organization's primary paid activity would change the core-activity entry; no such change is present in this proposal.
Reassessment date: 2027-04-20, or earlier if deciding evidence appears.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: HANDOFF → Creation Agent: What predecessors and development trajectory qualify the claimed image-production barrier, and what arc stage is supported?

HANDOFF → Innovation Agent: What performance-based DEGREE is supported against a named baseline? DEGREE could differ from this significance class because performance improvement does not establish categorical barrier dissolution.
HANDOFF → Diffusion Agent: How far have text-to-image diffusion systems spread, and what adopter position describes comparable small retailers?
HANDOFF → Adoption Agent: Whether, when and with which tool should this application be undertaken, and what application evidence or experiment design is appropriate?
HANDOFF → Organizational Adoption Agent: Can the two-person marketing function and owner support the required skills, ownership, review and governance?
HANDOFF → Landscape Agent: Which named peers, competitors and deployments provide relevant market and comparable-organization evidence?
Missing general evidence: a dated measured comparison against human-led image production; diffusion-specific suppression and dependency evidence; demonstrated tier-level effects.

Missing local evidence: selected model and version, current price and license, ideation cost share, actual local value and a dated comparable-retailer source. These gaps do not justify importing a stronger general classification.
